spdk.description: SPDK is a storage performance development kit.

libjsonc.description: JSON-C is a JSON implementation in C.

nvme-cli.description: nvme-cli is a utility for managing NVMe devices.

components.description: Single source of truth for the Go-module forks vendored into the longhorn-manager and longhorn-instance-manager images. Unlike the infra entries above (which the IM Dockerfile clones and builds directly), these are recorded here only for traceability — the actual pin is the go.mod `replace` directive in each consumer repo. Keep in lockstep when bumping. SHAs below are the convergent set for the IM .110 / manager .35 build.

longhorn-manager.note: Deployed as image tag v1.11.1-linkpool.35. Contains ctrlr-loss-(-1), dead-spdk_tgt probe, XFS resize gate, PR-A go-common-libs exec SIGKILL, pod-kick (cherry-pick of d81d433d4), force-delete hardening.

longhorn-instance-manager.note: Deployed as image tag v1.11.1-linkpool.110. Bundles spdk (linkpool.35), longhorn-spdk-engine (357b8fa), go-spdk-helper (b6ea1c9 library), types (a08cb4f), go-common-libs (fea5f24) via flattened vendor. go-spdk-helper CLI binary built from the go-spdk-helper entry above (a48cde4).

longhorn-spdk-engine.note: Vendored into IM (357b8fa) and manager (held at 6ea821a — manager does not run enginefrontend.Suspend). EF observer, dead-device probe on Suspend+prepareExpansion, teardown-wedge, RDMA transport, persistence.

longhorn-types.note: Proto/gRPC types. The IM/manager go.mod replace points at linkpoolio/types@a08cb4ff0b7a (pseudoversion v0.0.0-20260610091928-a08cb4ff0b7a), the rebase/main tip. Additive fields only (wire-compatible). NOTE: the feat/v2-rdma-transport branch (dc073dc) is a divergent alternative line and is NOT what is vendored.

go-common-libs.note: Fork of longhorn/go-common-libs. Single change: executeCmd SIGKILLs the child process on timeout (closes the orphan hole). Branched from upstream 1e84fa7 (the commit go-spdk-helper/spdk-engine already pinned; IM/manager pin c0739cd — source-identical, only a deps digest differs).

go-spdk-helper.note: Library pin in IM go.mod is b6ea1c9 (pre-this-tag); CLI binary built from the top-level go-spdk-helper entry (a48cde4). The 34f6939 tip adds the go-common-libs replace but the IM's flattened vendor provides the exec fix regardless of this pin. Bump IM's go.mod helper pin to 34f6939 for consistency in a follow-up.
